en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a riverside scene with traditional German half-timbered houses on the left, a stone embankment and calm water in the foreground, and the ruins of a medieval tower or castle on a wooded hill in the background. The title text at the top left identifies the location as Weida in Thuringia on the river Weida. A small red-printed publisher credit appears at the bottom right.
